# S08 — Add the disassembler and round-trip tests

Disassemble `isa.Cell` values back to source in `internal/asm` for debugging, expose it from `pit`, and prove asm -> disasm -> asm round-trips with table-driven and fuzz tests.

**Findings:** PROJECT.md Milestone 3 · **Size:** S · **Tree:** asm
Cites: C17 requirement: Assembler errors with line and column; asm-disasm-asm round-trips, C26 decision: Name: pitfight, CLI command pit, C34 constraint: Go caches stay in the repo; local checks, C35 constraint: Implementer decides unfixed interface details and records them

**Not in this slice:** source formatting beyond what the round trip needs.

## Why

Acceptance criterion C17 requires the round trip. Disassembly is the v1 debugging aid.

## Files

- `internal/asm/disasm.go`: `Disassemble([]isa.Cell) []byte` (or equivalent), output in the syntax of `docs/spec/asm.md`.
- `internal/asm/roundtrip_test.go`, and `FuzzRoundTrip` in `internal/asm/fuzz_test.go`.
- `cmd/pit/`: the disassembly entry point and its test.
- `docs/spec/asm.md`: a short section on disassembly output and the CLI entry point.

## Failing tests

- `TestRoundTripCells`: for every opcode, modifier and addressing mode (from `internal/isa`'s lists), `Assemble(Disassemble(cells)) == cells`.
- `TestRoundTripSpecExamples`: every example program in `docs/spec/isa.md` and `docs/spec/asm.md` (extracted from fenced code blocks) assembles, disassembles and reassembles to identical cells.
- `FuzzRoundTrip`: arbitrary bytes decoded into valid cells round-trip unchanged.
- A `cmd/pit` test: the disassembly entry point on a file under `t.TempDir()` prints source that reassembles to the same cells.

## Implement

- PROJECT.md does not say how disassembly is invoked. The implementer decides (a `pit disasm` subcommand or a `pit asm` flag) and records it per C35; the reviewer checks it.
- Last-writer ids are not part of the source and are excluded from the round-trip comparison.

## Check

- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal)"` passes.
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test -run '^$' -fuzz FuzzRoundTrip -fuzztime 60s ./internal/asm` finds no failure.
- Disassembling and reassembling each spec example gives identical cells (`TestRoundTripSpecExamples`).

## Git

Branch `slice/<id>-disassembler` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
